note: Reviewers under test must not read this file. Give them only the skill, the request, and the fixture repository built by build-fixture.mjs.

synthetic.purpose: A small change breaks an invariant that an unchanged direct consumer relies on.
synthetic.request: Review this PR with review-lite: 'Show 1-based step numbers in the progress label'.

rounds.message: Show 1-based step numbers in the progress label

expected.headline: Changes requested
expected.must_find: guide-runner.ts (unchanged) starts its loop at the now 1-based value, so resuming skips a step and the last step never runs; base returned the 0-based index.
expected.must_not: Block on comment style or on the progress label, which the PR updated consistently.

synthetic.purpose: An explicitly partial validation change must not be called a regression merely because the base was worse.
synthetic.request: Review this PR with review-lite: 'Block literal javascript: URLs in documentation links'. The accepted scope is only literal javascript: prefixes; subagents are not available in this run.

rounds.message: Block literal javascript: URLs in documentation links

expected.headline: Approve
expected.must_find: Nothing blocking. The embedded-control-character bypass (for example java\tscript:) remains outside the stated literal-prefix scope; it may be maintainer-owned separate work only with that accepted scope decision, not vague follow-up homework.
expected.must_not: Claim the PR widens a trust boundary, or require an allowlist rewrite as a merge condition without rejecting the explicit partial scope.

synthetic.purpose: Round 1 has a blocker; round 2 fixes it. The reviewer verifies the fix, carries prior separate work, and adds no new merge requirement.
synthetic.request: Review round 1 of this PR with review-lite: 'Pulse the highlighted element during Show me'. Then review round 2 with the round 1 state.

rounds.message: Pulse the highlighted element during Show me
Clear the pulse interval when Show me ends

expected.round_1_must_find: The interval is never cleared, so every Show me leaks a timer that keeps toggling a class on the element after the step ends.
expected.round_2_must_find: The round 1 blocker is resolved with head evidence; any legitimate round 1 separate work (for example reduced-motion handling) is carried, not re-raised as a requirement.
expected.must_not: Introduce a new round 2 merge requirement that round 1 could have raised, or turn carried maintainer-owned separate work into author homework.

synthetic.purpose: A declared external schema is material to a loader. An unavailable pinned source prevents a complete approval.
synthetic.request: Review this PR with review-lite: 'Move package loading to schema v2'. The PR cites https://schemas.example.invalid/packages/v2/9f4a3b7 as the normative schema, but that source cannot be fetched in this run.

rounds.message: Move package loading to schema v2

expected.headline: Review incomplete
expected.must_find: Register the PR-cited schema as a material governing input and leave the assessment incomplete while its pinned source is unavailable; do not approve from a green generic suite.
expected.must_not: Treat the unavailable schema as optional merely because the changed loader has no obvious caller in this fixture.

synthetic.purpose: An introduced defect in the PR's named deliverable remains a blocker even when the new code is not wired to a caller yet.
synthetic.request: Review this PR with review-lite: 'Reject non-finite or fractional tutorial progress before it can be persisted'. The helper is intentionally introduced for the next wiring change, but correctness of the claimed finite-integer validation is in scope now.

rounds.message: Reject non-finite or fractional tutorial progress before it can be persisted

expected.headline: Changes requested
expected.must_find: The claimed validator accepts Infinity and fractional values, so it does not establish a finite-integer persisted progress value; require that invariant before merge.
expected.must_not: Move this introduced, in-scope correctness defect to separate work solely because no caller currently invokes the helper.

synthetic.purpose: A conflict retry must preserve the newer schema returned by its reload rather than overwrite it with the stale first read.
synthetic.request: Review this PR with review-lite: 'Retry package save after a conflict'. The package contract says a retry must persist the freshly reloaded package unchanged.

rounds.message: Retry package save after a conflict

expected.headline: Changes requested
expected.must_find: After conflict, the second read is discarded and the stale original package is written again, overwriting the newer schema; require a retry scenario that proves the reloaded value is the one persisted.
expected.must_not: Approve merely because the retry path is rare or because the normal first write still succeeds.

skills.description: The pre-evidence-gates review-lite revision, retained unchanged for comparison.
This evidence-gated review-lite revision; do not promote it by plan alone.

models: Record each selected model version exactly; include the target contemporary models.
adoption_benchmark.design: Fully cross every frozen/revised skill with every selected model on the same pinned fixture or PR revision. This is a controlled model × skill promotion test, not a comparison with /review.
adoption_benchmark.controls: Hold revision, tools, knowledge snapshot (pass --knowledge pinned to one registry revision), execution permissions, and adjudication rubric constant within each model × skill cell. Disclose possible future-knowledge leakage for historical PRs.

historical_candidates.claim: A shortcut review missed three blocking regressions that the full pipeline found.
Validation-adding PR: most 'boundary widened' findings were inverted.
A low-severity, unreachable copy defect blocked a PR.
One finding blocked three rounds because the requirement stated a patch, not an invariant.
Four rounds with a new blocker ID every round.
Hand-written rounds lost continuity between reviews.
A stale contract-anchor finding was discarded by contract-evolution policy.
Two review arms disagreed on whether a controller path was part of the defect.

adoption_benchmark.candidate_caveat: Claims come from a secondhand handoff note. An independent adjudicator must establish the expected defects and acceptable merge decisions for each case before any arm is scored.
metrics: billed usage or cost where available; character counts and summed tokens are proxies only
adoption_benchmark.trials: Repeat at least three trials per model × skill cell on a subset including clean controls; report sample size limits instead of claiming equivalence.
adoption_benchmark.proposed_threshold: Agree before scoring. Suggested: no additional adjudicated material misses, no increase in unsupported blockers, and at least 50% lower median billed cost on routine cases.
